chassis.title: Cast Aluminum Chassis
chassis.description: Rigid precision-cast aluminum alloy housing with perimeter gasket channels and industry-standard 6-32 UNC mounting threads.

top_cover.title: Stainless Steel Cover & Breather
top_cover.description: Stamped stainless steel lid with perimeter elastomer seal and sub-micron breather filter equalizing internal barometric pressure.

platters.title: Dual Magnetic Recording Platters
platters.description: Polished aluminum-magnesium substrate disks coated with magnetic cobalt-alloy recording layers spinning at 7,200 RPM.

spindle_motor.title: Fluid Dynamic Bearing Spindle
spindle_motor.description: Brushless DC spindle motor utilizing fluid dynamic bearings (FDB) to dampen microscopic vibration and ensure rotational accuracy.

actuator_arm.title: Rotary Actuator Arm Assembly
actuator_arm.description: Balanced aluminum swing arm driven by the voice coil motor, translating angular motion into radial head track positioning.

rw_heads.title: Giant Magnetoresistive (GMR) Heads
rw_heads.description: Microscopic read/write slider elements aerodynamically flying nanometers above the spinning platter surface on an air bearing.

vcm_magnets.title: Voice Coil Motor (VCM) Magnets
vcm_magnets.description: High-strength rare-earth neodymium permanent magnet plates providing the fixed magnetic flux field for the actuator drive coil.

controller_pcb.title: Drive Controller PCB
controller_pcb.description: Underside circuit board housing the drive system-on-chip (SoC), spindle/VCM motor controller, DRAM cache buffer, and firmware.

sata_connectors.title: SATA Data & Power Connectors
sata_connectors.description: Standardized 7-pin SATA 6 Gb/s differential signaling interface and 15-pin DC power input connector with gold contacts.

parking_ramp.title: Head Load/Unload Parking Ramp
parking_ramp.description: Engineered low-friction polymer ramp safely capturing and parking the head assembly off the platter surface during power-down.
